messages:
Tom: heads-up — marking this P1 and handing to CS. VanguardHealth (trial) is blocked in onboarding: private deployment provisioning fails with repeated retries, `403` on KMS attach. They’re in the middle of an evaluation and renewal touch is in ~12 days. Support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/5423 :rotating_light:

Tom: brief logs (sanitized):
```
ERROR 2026-05-07T15:02:11Z Provisioner: attachKey failed status=403 kms:AccessDenied
Trace: Provisioner.attach -> kms.attachKey -> 403
Retries exhausted after 5 attempts
```

Aisha: adding CS owners. Thanks for the flag, Tom. I’ll take lead on comms with VanguardHealth. Can you confirm whether any data was affected or if this is purely provisioning? Also tag sales (cc @Priya) — we need to lock renewal risk ASAP. :eyes:

Tom: no data loss, purely provisioning/auth — sensitive keys not attached so flow blocked. Customer saw the error in the console and paused onboarding. I set severity to P1 because it blocks their trial acceptance.

Devon: investigating now. Early signal suggests a regression in KMS role binding after a recent deploy (infra change). I can push a temporary workaround: manual service-key attach + forced reprovision for the account. ETA 30–45m.

Priya: thanks — comms plan from CS side:
- Owner: Aisha (CS) — customer-facing updates + renewal flagging
- Support owner: Tom — ticket updates + monitoring
- Eng owner: Devon — triage & workaround
- Sales: Priya — renewal touch and credit consideration

Immediate customer message (send within 20m): short + transparent + next ETA. Draft: ```Hi Alex — we’re seeing an infrastructure issue blocking provisioning for your trial. Our engineering team has a temporary workaround and we expect reprovisioning within ~45 minutes. We’ll keep you updated every 30 minutes and confirm once your workspace is ready. Apologies for the disruption — Aisha (CS) will coordinate next steps.```

Priya: internal comms: ping sales and AM, update account renewal risk to HIGH, create a follow-up action to offer extended trial/credit if they request.

Aisha: I’ll send the customer draft now (short note) and create a 30-min sync in 1 hour to review. Also creating a renewal-risk card in Gainsight + noting incident in the account timeline.

Tom: applied workaround at +32m; forced reprovision succeeded for VanguardHealth. Logs show key attached manually and provisioning completed. Marking ticket with workaround steps. :white_check_mark:

Tom: relevant snippet for postmortem:
```
# workaround steps used:
1) service-account create-temp-key --account=vanguard
2) kms attach-temp-key --id=temp-key-123
3) provision --force --account=vanguard
```

Aisha: confirmed customer report — they can log in and complete onboarding. I’ve scheduled a check-in tomorrow morning and updated renewal risk to High. I’ll propose a small credit during renewal conversation.

Devon: will open rollback/patch PR to prevent this from reoccurring, and add a smoke test for KMS attach on every infra deploy. Assigned to eng-runtime team.

Priya: good work team. Please paste the final ticket link and the PR in here once available. We’ll run a short postmortem and a proactive outreach summary for the customer. ops-bot: create incident record for PS-5423.

ops-bot: Incident PS-5423 created and linked to ticket 5423. Participants auto-notified.

Aisha: closing handoff — CS will own follow-up. Leaving thread for visibility. :thumbsup:
